result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly coherent, but several visual defects stand out: a persistent loading spinner overlaying an already-loaded restaurant card image, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, an inconsistent favorite (heart) button style between the two cards, and content clipped at the bottom edge above the tab bar.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' hero card shows a circular loading spinner in the center even though the image behind it has clearly already rendered. This makes the card look stuck/broken and obscures the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image onLoad event fires, and ensure the spinner is not layered above successfully loaded images.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off by the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card itself is clipped mid-image, giving no clear affordance that it scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek width so the next card is partially visible by design, and apply text truncation with an ellipsis to card titles.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single style (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white heart) across all cards.

issues.description: The second promoted card (pizza, −20%) is cut off abruptly by the bottom tab bar with no visible name, rating, or spacing, making the page look truncated rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards scroll cleanly and never appear half-hidden at rest.

issues.description: The '€0.90 delivery' / '€2.40 delivery' subtitles and 'See all' green links are low-contrast light gray/green on white, which may fall below WCAG AA for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and link colors to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The notification bell shows a red dot badge with no accessible label or count, so screen reader users get no indication of unread notifications.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' to the bell button.
